The '''elytra''' can be smithed with [[Shakudo Alloy|shakudo]] or [[Hepatizon Alloy|hepatizon alloy]] into two alloy elytra.

== Matcha elytra ==
Wearing an unenchanted, unmodified elytra replaces it with the pack's elytra, which is repaired with wax or feathers.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/item_contingencies/elytra.mcfunction}}</ref>

== Shakudo Elytra ==
{{Infobox auto|Shakudo Elytra}}
{{Recipes|Shakudo Elytra}}
800 durability, 1 armor, [[Magic protection]] 20, Cleanse Maleffect and the shakudo regeneration intrinsic. Its tooltip lists an "Elytra Bonus" of 10 seconds off the regeneration timer, but the item carries the normal armor intrinsic, so it counts as one more shakudo piece; the elytra intrinsic that counts as five pieces exists but is not on the item.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/shakudo_elytra.json}}</ref> Repaired with honeycomb blocks or blocks of copper.

== Hepatizon Elytra ==
{{Recipes|item.kleispack.hepatizon_elytra}}
800 durability, 1 armor and +0.02 movement speed (20%). Repaired with honeycomb blocks or blocks of copper. The recipe and loot table name it with the key <code>item.kleispack.hepatizon_elytra</code>, but the language file only has <code>item.kleispack.bronze_elytra</code>, so the item shows its raw key as its name.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/hepatizon_elytra.json}}</ref>

== Advancements ==
* ''Wax Wings'': obtain an elytra. ''Icarus' Folly'': smith hepatizon elytra. ''Wings of Eros'': smith shakudo elytra.
